items.quote: We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%

items.quote: We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7%
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: We're maintaining our credit cost guidance of 3% to 4%
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: Cost to income may range between 29% to 30%
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: we expect the Group Loan book growth to return to guided levels
items.statement: Group Loan book growth to return to guided levels in H2FY27
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.quote: you should assume that it will be somewhere between 3.5% to 4%
items.statement: Credit cost likely between 3.5-4% for the year
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan

items.statement: Borrowing cost to stay at 9.2-9.3% until Mar-2027

items.quote: our targeted ROA of 4.5% to 5% on a steady-state basis

items.statement: About 6-8% of customers per year to convert to individual loans
items.speaker: Ganesh Narayanan
